root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: every copied `static_array[i].values.arrayZ_` is NULL before `memcpy (new_array, static_array, len * sizeof (Type))`
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `hb_vector_t<CFF1FontDictValues>::alloc()` raw-copies inline `static_array` entries into `new_array`, none of the copied inline font-dict slots may already own a heap-backed nested `values.arrayZ_`; otherwise the byte copy duplicates ownership into the heap slot while leaving the inline owner live.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable inline-to-heap migration copies at least one live nested `OpStr` owner out of `static_array` with `memcpy`. The fixed program still reaches the same copy site for this PoC, but the copied witness slot no longer has a live nested `values.arrayZ_` there, so the raw copy does not duplicate a live owner for this execution.

edges.relation: The witness nested-owner pointer selected from the copied inline range is copied byte-for-byte into the corresponding heap slot by the raw `memcpy`.
The same copied heap-owner pointer later reaches `hb_vector_t<CFF::OpStr, 8u>::fini()` while `fontDicts.fini_deep()` walks the heap copy, so cleanup frees that `OpStr` buffer once.

After cleanup frees the witness pointer once from the heap copy, later destruction of the stale inline owner reaches the same `free(arrayZ_)` sink with that pointer again, producing the AddressSanitizer double-free.
